# SUNPOWER

SUNPOWER is a solar energy dealership and EPC/MMS contracting firm serving Delhi NCR, India.

## Services

- Residential rooftop solar for homes, including system sizing, roof checks, and subsidy support
- Commercial and industrial solar for facilities, rooftops, and ground-mounted projects
- MMS mounting structure contracting, fabrication, erection, and EPC coordination
- Solar batteries and inverters for on-grid, hybrid, and backup-ready systems
- PM Surya Ghar subsidy assistance for eligible homeowners

## Project scale

SUNPOWER supports residential systems commonly ranging from 3-5 kW and commercial or industrial project scopes up to 1 MW. Final system sizing, pricing, savings, and payback depend on the site survey, electricity usage, roof conditions, equipment selection, and applicable approvals.
